# LNT004 `preprocessor-assumption`

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A preprocessor condition could not be evaluated and was assumed true.

## Why

The linter evaluates `#if` conditions with the build mode's defines to analyse the code the compiler
sees. When an expression is beyond its evaluator (function-like macros, unknown operators) the
branch is assumed taken: findings in or around it may not match the compiled code.

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[LNT004] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = LNT004` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).
